New design removes every whole contour highlight and instead binds two ordered edge pairs at the actual convex source tail corners to two E boundary corners whose red-to-blue turns have opposite sign. This is a specific false reflected-part assignment, with source handedness evidence and no added seam. Actual E has different valid rotated decompositions. Reusing presetE does not reuse the old image or salience mechanism.
primary_math_proof: Each source arrow is the union of a unit-area isosceles right triangular head and a unit-square stem, totalarea2. Fresh polygon computation supplies explicit two-rotation/translation tilings of A,B,C,E. For D the long exposed diagonal has length2sqrt2; each piece can contribute at most one edge on this support line. At45degree source rotations two unit-axis edges total2 cannot cover2sqrt2, so both contributing edges must be the head edges of lengthsqrt2 under90degree rotations. They meet at the diagonal midpoint, forcing a finite set of placements; none can be a contained disjoint pair. Thus D alone is impossible. The marked source corner and marked E corners have opposite boundary traversal signs, but the source-to-E matching is an optional incorrect correspondence: it does not prevent E actual tiling. No interior partition or seam is drawn.
